verified_claims.text: A high-similarity gnomAD-SV candidate INS_chr3_9224a6a5 is reported at chromosome 3:49404094-49404095 with a length of 126 bp, an allele frequency of 0.15904 (17,585 of 110,570 alleles), and a HIGH_NCR filter status.
verified_claims.notes: The gnomAD-SV record perfectly matches the described properties, including length, frequency, and filter.

verified_claims.text: Eight dbVar records (nsv3552129, nsv3947452, nsv4438715, nsv5167875, nsv5535033, nsv5605727, nsv5948684, nsv6062347) document insertions or mobile element insertions matching coordinate 3:49404094 exactly.
verified_claims.notes: All eight dbVar records have exact coordinate matches of 3:49404094-49404094 and are compatible types.

verified_claims.text: A mobile element insertion from study nstd203 (nsv5166842) matches the insertion region via a partial region overlap (3:49404092-49404144).
verified_claims.notes: dbVar record nsv5166842 spans 3:49404092-49404144 as a mobile element insertion from nstd203, establishing regional overlap.; Cited database records do not establish an exact or high-similarity match.

verified_claims.text: An insertion from study nstd162 (nsv3380534) matches near coordinate 3:49404095.
verified_claims.notes: dbVar record nsv3380534 matches at the adjacent 3:49404095 coordinate.; Cited database records do not establish an exact or high-similarity match.

verified_claims.text: General literature on RHOA describes its roles in cell motility, 3D invasive migration, and interactions with other proteins such as Septin11 and phospholipase C̵, but does not reference this specific insertion.
verified_claims.notes: The literature references describe various biological activities of RHOA but do not describe or validate this specific structural variant.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: Literature on the Genome in a Bottle (GIAB) consortium and sequencing methodologies outlines benchmark pipelines and RNA-seq diagnostic validation but does not provide direct evidence for this specific insertion.
verified_claims.notes: The cited PMIDs reference generic benchmark methodologies and pipeline validation papers rather than this specific insertion.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: It is hypothesized that the 663 bp insertion is an intronic mobile element insertion in RHOA, as indicated by the intronic consequence annotation of the highly similar gnomAD candidate INS_chr3_9224a6a5 and the exact coordinate overlap with several RHOA transcript spans.
verified_claims.notes: The hypothesis is logically sound and directly supported by the intronic status of the highly similar gnomAD candidate INS_chr3_9224a6a5 and the overlap with the canonical RHOA transcript model.; A hypothesis is not an established finding.

verified_claims.text: The technical quality and alignment validity of the insertion call cannot be established due to unknown artifact risks regarding call rate, single caller support, repeat region status, low mappability, and genotype quality.
verified_claims.notes: All corresponding artifact risk features are marked as unknown.
